message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain false. With those bypass conditions unavailable, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, file server, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique. One control cannot suffice: mfa:admin alone leaves CI-server secret theft and database-admin authentication available; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration; segmented alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation or laptop. Any single patch or mfa:user also leaves a complete attack path available."}
